description: Java class 'ModelFieldType' representing a field type in the entity model, including attributes for SQL and Java types, and methods for handling XML initialization and type-related utilities.

classes.name: ModelFieldType
classes.description: Represents a field type in the entity model, with attributes for type, Java type, SQL type, and JDBC handler, and methods for initialization and utility functions.

methods.name: ModelFieldType
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelFieldType object from an XML element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type of the field.

methods.name: getJdbcValueHandler
methods.description: Returns the JDBC value handler for this field type.

methods.name: getSqlType
methods.description: Returns the SQL type of the field.

methods.name: getSqlTypeAlias
methods.description: Returns the SQL type alias of the field.

methods.name: stringLength
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum string length based on the SQL type.
